import Mathlib.Order.WellFounded

namespace Acc

variable {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Prop}

open Relation

theorem not_not_descending_chain_ends_of_acc {p : α → Prop} {a : α} (acc : Acc r a) {f : Nat → α}
    (hsta : f 0 = a)
    (hcon : ∀ ⦃n : Nat⦄, p (f n) → f (n + 1) = f n)
    (hdes : ∀ ⦃n : Nat⦄, ¬p (f n) → r (f (n + 1)) (f n)) :
    ¬¬∃ (c : Nat), p (f c) ∧ ∀ ⦃m : Nat⦄, c ≤ m → f m = f c := by
  -- Proof by contradiction
  intro h
  -- h says: ¬∃ c, p (f c) ∧ ∀ m, c ≤ m → f m = f c
  -- We claim that ∀ c, ¬p (f c)
  suffices ∀ c, ¬p (f c) by
    -- If ∀ c, ¬p (f c), then by hdes, we get a descending chain
    have : ∃ g : Nat → α, g 0 = a ∧ ∀ n, r (g (n + 1)) (g n) := by
      refine ⟨f, hsta, fun n => hdes (this n)⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg0, hgr⟩ := this
    -- This contradicts acc
    -- acc : Acc r a means there's no descending chain starting from a
    -- But g is such a chain
    have : IsEmpty { f : Nat → α // f 0 = a ∧ ∀ n, r (f (n + 1)) (f n) } := by
      rw [← acc_iff_isEmpty_descending_chain]
      exact acc
    exact this.false ⟨g, hg0, hgr⟩
  -- Now prove ∀ c, ¬p (f c)
  intro c hpc
  -- Suppose p (f c), derive contradiction
  -- If p (f c), then by hcon, f (c + 1) = f c, and by induction f m = f c for all m ≥ c
  have : ∀ m, c ≤ m → f m = f c := fun m hcm => by
    induction m, hcm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => rfl
    | succ m hmn ih =>
      -- m + 1 ≥ c, and we have ih : f m = f c
      -- We need to show f (m + 1) = f c
      -- We have f m = f c by ih, so p (f m) by p (f c) and ih
      -- Then f (m + 1) = f m by hcon (ih ▸ hpc)
      -- So f (m + 1) = f m = f c
      have : p (f m) := ih ▸ hpc
      calc f (m + 1)
        _ = f m := hcon this
        _ = f c := ih
  -- So we have p (f c) ∧ ∀ m, c ≤ m → f m = f c
  -- This contradicts h
  exact h ⟨c, hpc, this⟩

end Acc

I figured out the format. If it helps, here is a lean-auto-approve.toml that can be used with vibe --agent lean-auto-approve:

display_name = "Lean (auto-edit)"
description = "Lean 4 proof assistant that auto-approves file edits"
safety = "destructive"
auto_approve = true
active_model = "leanstral"
system_prompt_id = "lean"

[[providers]]
name = "mistral"
api_base = "https://api.mistral.ai/v1"
api_key_env_var = "MISTRAL_API_KEY"
backend = "mistral"

[[models]]
name = "labs-leanstral-2603"
provider = "mistral"
alias = "leanstral"
thinking = "high"
temperature = 1.0
auto_compact_threshold = 168000

[tools.bash]
default_timeout = 1200
